where: label rules (LABEL_RULES, LABEL_SENTENCE, namedWeapons, OWN_TARGET)
why: General: no ability names in code (names appear only in why/comments). Checked ~70 derived labels against GW's words (all 203 newly matching places plus the Not-read list): correct. Three tidy-ups: (1) label-other-unit (/^while a unit is\b/) over-matches Waaagh! ('While a unit is riled up: - That unit has 5+ InSv …' is the army's own units, not a unit the item selected) — no visible effect today (Waaagh! is unread) but the rule should require the state the item put on a selected unit ('that unit is wracked with agonies'); (2) label-enemy-cannot-move (/…\bmove\b/) would also catch 'cannot end a Charge move' — limit it to Normal/Advance/Fall Back moves (Bio-minefield unchanged); (3) label-own-target's why is wrong by the Core Rules: snap shooting (15.09) can target any visible eligible enemy within 24", not 'the enemy unit that just moved'; it is a labelling choice matching the signed-off labels (and hit modifiers/re-rolls do nothing in snap shooting). Tested: no label changes.

where: Orks · Shoota Boyz rule · Dakka! Dakka! Dakka!
why: Removal not needed: the program's reading {movement:either, shooting:your} is the correct label and the signed-off one was wrong. [ASSAULT] = your Shooting phase after an Advance (Your Move, as Onslaught's signed-off label shows for the same words) + Fire Overwatch in their Movement phase; nothing makes these units shoot in the opponent's Shooting phase, so the signed-off 'Shoot (either turn)' was an error. Correction: 'Their Move · Shoot' → 'Move · Your Shoot'.

where: Emperor’s Children army rule · Thrill Seekers
why: Removal not needed: show the program's reading Your Move/Shoot/Charge. Same words as Royal Warden's Adaptive Strategy ('eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back': signed off Your Move/Shoot/Charge) and Bounding Leaps/Elevated Strider (Your Move/Shoot); the Thrill Seekers row was the outlier. No general rule can drop Move here without changing those signed-off rows. Correction: 'Your Shoot/Charge' → 'Your Move/Shoot/Charge'.

where: Chaos Knights · Houndpack Lance rule · Marked Prey
why: Removal not needed: the program's reading {command:your, shooting:your, fight:either} is exactly the signed-off Worthy Foes label for the same structure ('select one enemy unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a X model … makes an attack that targets that unit, …'). By GW's words the selection is in your Command phase and the bonus is on attacks (shooting and fight). Correction: 'Your Command' → 'Your Command/Shoot · Fight'.

where: pubstomper · Defiler · Scuttling Walker
why: Removal not needed: the program reads Your Move, the same label the identical words carry on defilers-and-friends' two Defiler rows (signed off). Normal/Advance/Fall Back moves are your Movement phase; nothing in the text concerns shooting, so the pubstomper 'Your Move/Shoot' was the error. Correction: 'Your Move/Shoot' → 'Your Move'.

where: purge-goes-the-foe · Thulia Ghuld · Icon of War
why: A general rule fixes it (label-section + label-named-option, in the derive.js diff under 076f74fba1dcddc9; only this row changes on all 25 lists). The program then reads Rod of the War Forge's trigger (Your Command: per the FAQ the unit is selected when the ability is selected) + Fanatical Devotion / Adaptive Tactics (Your Move/Shoot/Charge: shoot and charge after an Advance/Fall Back, as Adaptive Strategy is signed off) + The Fires of Mars (the Conqueror and Protector Imperatives' rows: your Shooting, the Fight phase, and Fire Overwatch in their Movement phase since it lasts to your next Command phase) = Your Command · Move · Your Shoot · Your Charge · Fight. Against the signed-off label: Move gains Your (correction, Advance/Fall Back convention); Shoot loses 'either turn' (correction: none of the three options acts in the opponent's Shooting phase; Protector's melee -1 to hit is the Fight phase).

where: Adeptus Custodes · Aquilan Shield rule · Gilded Guardians
why: Neither proposed label is right by GW's words. The protection is left out (label-no-defence, as Flare Shields), so the catalog reviewer's 'Your Move · Their Shoot' (the protection's phases) is not the label. The Additional Effect (+6" R) is granted only when the Salvus ka'tah is used, and Salvus's WHEN is 'Your Shooting phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to shoot' — so it never applies to Fire Overwatch (opponent's Movement phase). Correct label: Your Shoot only; the builder's 'Their Move · Your Shoot' wrongly adds Overwatch. label-favoured reads this (tested with GW's text: {shooting:your}). Table 1 (checklist) {shooting:either, movement:either} is right for the protection.
fix: label {ph:['shooting'], turn:'your'} via label-favoured (derive.js diff under 076f74fba1dcddc9; wt-catalog's rule ctx needs the same option lookup).
